title: Tiger cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#1a2a3a'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#e8821a'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M34 68 Q38 72 34 78' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 64 Q46 69 42 76' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 64 Q54 69 58 76' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 68 Q62 72 66 78' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#ffe0a0'/>

  <!-- left arm holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8821a' transform='rotate(-20 32 66)'/>
  <!-- right arm holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8821a' transform='rotate(20 68 66)'/>

  <!-- book left page -->
  <rect x='30' y='58' width='20' height='15' rx='1' fill='#ffd966' stroke='#cc9900' stroke-width='1' transform='rotate(-5 40 62)'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <rect x='50' y='56' width='20' height='15' rx='1' fill='#ffd966' stroke='#cc9900' stroke-width='1' transform='rotate(5 60 62)'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='57' x2='50' y2='73' stroke='#cc9900' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- text lines on left page -->
  <line x1='34' y1='63' x2='46' y2='62' stroke='#cc6600' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='66' x2='46' y2='65' stroke='#cc6600' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='69' x2='44' y2='68' stroke='#cc6600' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- text lines on right page -->
  <line x1='54' y1='61' x2='66' y2='60' stroke='#cc6600' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='64' x2='66' y2='63' stroke='#cc6600' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='67' x2='64' y2='66' stroke='#cc6600' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#e8821a'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='7' fill='#e8821a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='4' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='7' fill='#e8821a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='4' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  
  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <path d='M44 32 Q47 36 44 40' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 30 Q50 35 50 50' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='0' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M56 32 Q53 36 56 40' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheek stripes -->
  <path d='M30 44 Q34 44 36 46' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 50 Q34 50 36 48' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 44 Q66 44 64 46' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 50 Q66 50 64 48' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ffe0a0'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#1a2a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='42' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#1a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 49 L53 49 L50 52 Z' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q47 56 44 54' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 52 Q53 56 56 54' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='48' x2='38' y2='50' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='53' x2='38' y2='53' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='48' x2='62' y2='50' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='53' x2='62' y2='53' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 78 Q82 74 80 64' stroke='#e8821a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 68 L82 66' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 72 L80 70' stroke='#1a2a3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#e8821a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#e8821a'/>
</svg>
